description: Two weaknesses that are about WHICH code or WHICH keys, rather than about text being interpreted. The module loader requires a whole value for the same reason a request destination does: `require('./handlers/' + name)` is what every plugin loader ever written looks like, and reporting them all would make the rule unusable. That is a trade rather than a safety argument -- a leaf containing `../` escapes the directory -- and the fixture says so. The deep merge is mass assignment with a sharper edge, because merge walks nested keys and `__proto__` is one.

expected.note: the caller names the module and the runtime runs it
the caller's whole object is merged key by nested key into a shared object
